body.x: Black Rapid(www.blackrapid.com) announced 'Straps Series' at 'PMDA(PhotoImaging Manufacturers and Distributors Association)' show that is being held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

The strap is curved to fit over the shoulder and there is a small supplementary strap that goes under the arm, keeping the strap stable and preventing it from riding up towards the neck or sliding down off the arm. The strap is wide enough and padded enough to be comfortable. In addition, the strap includes a mounting swivel, which allows the gear to slide up the strap while the strap remaining in the same position on the shoulder thanks to the underarm stabilizing strap. Also, cameras and lens slide up to my eye level quickly with no problems and resistance.
